Web design & development

Websites that make your business easier to trust.

From a focused one-page website to a custom multi-page site — designed with care, built to work on every screen, and launched with a clear handover.

Start a website projectSee concept projects

What we build

Everything a business website needs. Nothing it doesn't.

We design and develop websites that are fast, readable, privacy-friendly and easy to maintain.

  • 01

    One-page websites

    A complete, focused presence on a single page — ideal for trades, studios and local businesses.

  • 02

    Custom websites

    Multi-page sites with a structure designed around your services, customers and goals.

  • 03

    Landing pages

    Single-purpose pages for a campaign, an offer or a new service.

  • 04

    Redesigns & improvements

    A clearer structure, better mobile experience and faster pages for an existing website.

  • 05

    Multilingual websites

    Sites in up to five languages, with content translated by us — not by a machine plugin.

  • 06

    Privacy-friendly setup

    No unnecessary trackers, a proper consent setup where needed and complete legal pages.

Packages

Transparent from the start.

A defined entry-level package for small businesses, and individual quotes for everything larger.

Starter website

from €99one-time

A professional one-page website for a small business, typically delivered within 48 hours after we have received all content.

Included

  • One responsive page with up to 6 sections
  • Your texts, photos and logo, carefully laid out
  • Contact section with phone, email, address and map link
  • Privacy-friendly setup and links to your legal pages
  • Launch on your existing domain

Not included / extra

  • Domain and hosting costs
  • Writing or translating your texts
  • Additional pages, booking or shop functions
  • Logo or photo production
  • Ongoing changes after launch
Order a starter website

Custom website

On requestquoted per project

For businesses that need several pages, more languages or special functions. You receive a fixed quote after a short consultation.

Included

  • Discovery call and page structure
  • Individual visual design
  • Multi-page, multilingual build
  • Testing on real devices and browsers
  • Deployment, handover and documentation
Request a quote

Prices exclude VAT where applicable. Anything outside a package is quoted before work starts — you decide whether you want it.

Our approach

A clear process, without surprises.

Every project follows the same four steps, with a defined scope and an agreed price before work begins.

  1. 01

    Discover

    We get to know your business, your audience and your goals — and agree on what the project includes.

  2. 02

    Design

    We develop a considered visual direction and page structure, and refine it with your feedback.

  3. 03

    Build

    We develop the website, test it on real devices and browsers, and fix what needs fixing.

  4. 04

    Launch

    We deploy the site and hand over clear information on how it works and what comes next.

After launch

A clean handover, and clear boundaries.

You should know exactly what you're getting — and what happens after the website goes live.

  • →

    Deployment

    We publish the site on your domain and check that everything works in production.

  • →

    Handover

    You receive the access details and a short guide to how your website is set up.

  • →

    Maintenance

    Updates and changes after launch are not included in a package. We offer them on request, at a quoted price.
